title: The ticket file is nothing but the build plan
intention: A ticket's plan file carries nothing but the build plan: the store charter's plan_fields narrow from 56 to what a builder builds from and what a gate reads to let the build cross, and every other field moves to the ticket's log.
why: Akien, 2026-10-29: "We talked about splitting up tickets into the ticket plan and the ticket log. the ticket becomes nothing but the build plan. that's what makes this work." Measured that day: CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json declares 56 plan_fields, among them trail-shaped keys (build_commits, measurements_since_cast, closed_by, proved, notes, deposits), so the plan file still carries the trail the 10-10 split meant to move.
traces_to: Law 5 (the address carries what a mind needs now: the plan is the now, the log the trail); Law 1 (a builder re-reading the trail re-derives the settled); the spanning intention CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-a-ticket-is-a-plan-and-a-log.md, whose plan carries 'only the fields the store charter's plan_fields declares'; c9897770efe6 (the rehearsal reads only the plan)
how: Measure, per plan field, its readers across cairn/ and skills/ (which door, gate or render reads it) and its fill count across CairnCommons/tickets/. Keep a field in plan_fields when rehearsal's render hands it to the builder or a crossing gate reads it from the plan; every other field becomes a log kind 'field' line through ticket_log's existing split, one deterministic migration over every ticket, through the artifact door. Each reader of a moved field reads it from the log through ticket_log, never from the plan. The narrowed list and its per-field reason go into CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json.
falsifier: Done when: plan_fields in CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json lists only fields with a named builder-or-gate reader (each with its reason), every ticket file holds only those keys, every moved value stands on its ticket's log as a 'field' line, and every proof under cairn/ that reads a moved field reads it from the log and stays green. Wrong intent if a crossing gate or the rehearsal reds on a real ticket for want of a moved field, i.e. something a builder or gate needs lived in the trail.
watchme: none, because the horizon is readable on the record without a probe: every refused crossing is journaled by the emit chokepoint in each component's history.json (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py), so 'no refusal names a moved field in the next five crossings' is a read of those journals at the close
children: none, because the census decides the build count; if it shows readers in more than one component, /chart's decompose splits the work and any child is cast then (ticket 76da3a283277 is the precedent)

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder would ask: which fields stay (answered by the census plus open-c7809a745bf7); how a reader reads a moved field (ticket_log's read_log over kind 'field', found by name); whether the migration is one act or per-field (one deterministic run through the artifact door, like 29569fca68a3); what happens to a ticket cast after the narrowing with a non-plan key (cast_ticket's split puts it on the log, as today); whether rehearsal records or questions change (no). Each becomes a D-line at /chart once the census is taken.
